temporalCoverage.samplingFrequency: Static Infrastructure Topology / Periodic Survey Updates

fields.name: edge_id
fields.description: Graph edge connecting two signalized or unsignalized intersections

fields.name: length_m
fields.description: Geodetic length of road segment calculated on WGS84

fields.description: Statutory speed limit (default 50.0 km/h on Nagar Road arterial)

fields.name: geometry
fields.description: WGS-84 polyline coordinates of road centerline

intendedUse: Study area digital twin 2D MapLibre visualization, road asset registration, and SUMO netconvert microscopic network topology generation.
prohibitedClaims: Must not claim that lane counts, turning restrictions, or signal cycle lengths reflect real-time adaptive traffic management system (ATMS) operations without formal field calibration.
knownLimitations: OSM data contains community-mapped geometries; informal turn bays, construction diversions, and unregulated curb usages require periodic ground-truth validation.
privacySensitivityAssessment: Public spatial infrastructure data only. Contains no personal, vehicle, or surveillance telemetry.
